health.title: Level 2 - Chikungunya in Honduras
health.subject: Chikungunya in Honduras
health.summary: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in El Paraíso, Honduras. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.

health.title: Level 2 - Yellow Fever in the Republic of South Sudan
health.subject: Yellow Fever in the Republic of South Sudan
health.summary: There is an outbreak of yellow fever in Yei and Morobo Counties of South Sudan.

health.title: Level 1 - Multidrug-Resistant Typhoid Fever in Senegal
health.subject: Multidrug-Resistant Typhoid Fever in Senegal
health.summary: Cases of multidrug-resistant (MDR) typhoid fever are being reported among returning travelers from Senegal.

health.title: Level 2 - Malaria in Panama
health.subject: Malaria in Panama
health.summary: Increased cases of malaria have been reported in areas of Panama that were previously considered no-risk.

health.title: Level 1 - Global Dengue
health.subject: Global Dengue
health.summary: Dengue is a year-round risk in many parts of the world, with outbreaks commonly occurring every 2–5 years. Travelers to risk areas should prevent mosquito bites.

health.title: Level 2 - Yellow Fever in Burkina Faso, Côte d’Ivoire, and Ghana
health.subject: Yellow Fever in Burkina Faso, Côte d’Ivoire, and Ghana
health.summary: There are outbreaks of yellow fever in the Nando Region of Burkina Faso, Bounkani Region of Côte d’Ivoire, and the Upper West Region of Ghana. Travelers to these regions should take steps to prevent yellow fever by getting vaccinated at least 10 days before travel and taking steps to prevent mosquito bites.

health.title: Level 1 - Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Kenya
health.subject: Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Kenya
health.summary: The Kenyan Ministry of Health has confirmed an imported case, as well as other linked cases, of Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus in Nairobi, Kenya.

health.title: Level 2 - Yellow Fever in Colombia
health.subject: Yellow Fever in Colombia
health.summary: An increased number of cases of yellow fever have been reported in Colombia.

health.title: Level 2 - Global Polio
health.subject: Global Polio
health.summary: Some international destinations have circulating poliovirus. Before any international travel, make sure you are up to date on your polio vaccines.

health.title: Level 1 - Hepatitis A in Costa Rica
health.subject: Hepatitis A in Costa Rica
health.summary: There is an outbreak of hepatitis A (HAV) in Costa Rica. Most cases have been reported in San José province.

health.title: Level 2 - Chikungunya in Nicaragua
health.subject: Chikungunya in Nicaragua
health.summary: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in Nicaragua. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.

health.title: Level 2 - Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda
health.subject: Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda
health.summary: CDC recommends practicing enhanced precautions for travel to Uganda or to provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) not affected by the current Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak.

health.title: Level 1 - Paratyphoid Fever in Yemen
health.subject: Paratyphoid Fever in Yemen
health.summary: Cases of paratyphoid fever are being reported in returning travelers from Yemen. You can prevent paratyphoid fever by practicing safe eating and drinking habits.

health.title: Level 1 - Diphtheria in Sub-Saharan Africa
health.subject: Diphtheria in Sub-Saharan Africa
health.summary: There are outbreaks of diphtheria in several countries in Africa. Vaccination against diphtheria is essential to protect against the disease.

health.title: Level 2 - Zika in Indonesia
health.subject: Zika in Indonesia
health.summary: Cases of Zika are being reported in returning travelers from Bali, Indonesia. All travelers to Bali should take steps to prevent mosquito bites and sexual transmission of Zika virus during and after travel.

health.title: Level 4 - Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Ituri and Nord-Kivu Provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
health.subject: Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Ituri and Nord-Kivu Provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
health.summary: CDC recommends avoiding all travel to Ituri and Nord-Kivu (North-Kivu) provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) due to the current Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak unless traveling for humanitarian aid or emergency response.

health.subject: Hepatitis A in Canada

health.title: Level 1 - Global Measles
health.subject: Global Measles
health.summary: Measles cases are rising in many countries around the world. All international travelers should be fully vaccinated against measles with the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine, according to CDC's measles vaccination recommendations for international travel.
